name: Block Disposable Emails
description: Reject sign-up attempts from known disposable email providers (mailinator, guerrillamail, tempmail, etc.). Reduces fraud and ensures real user email addresses.

custom_domains.description: Comma-separated list of additional domains to block

config.program: let domain = request.identifier split '@' | last(); let blocked = ['mailinator.com','guerrillamail.com','tempmail.com','throwaway.email','yopmail.com','sharklasers.com','grr.la','guerrillamailblock.com','pokemail.net','spam4.me','dispostable.com','trashmail.com','10minutemail.com','getnada.com','maildrop.cc']; domain in blocked ? {"action": "deny", "reason": "Disposable email addresses are not allowed"} : {"action": "allow"}
